alts: Before: typing pricing on chat daily. After: your page answers instantly.

Slide 2 of 5: The before picture: answering the same questions every day. Example: whether you run a clinic, gym, or studio, multiple inquiries ask for basic rates. You stop work to retype packages, while customers wait for answers before deciding.

Slide 3 of 5: Design decision: structured pricing turns a page into an FAQ. A website is not just a digital brochure. Placing clean pricing blocks and clear service details on a fast single page lets visitors find answers on their own.

Slide 4 of 5: The after picture: clarity before the conversation starts. Customers open the link, review your offerings, and resolve simple doubts immediately. Inquiries that do arrive on chat are already informed and ready to talk.
